searchText: is there a forkmon instance up for Shapella? https://forkmon.mainnet.ethpandaops.io a little rough but looking better now? Pretty much what I would have expected - you tend to get a few missed blocks early because the state upgrade takes a bit of time to go through which makes things late (plus a chance that the proposer failed to upgrade in time). fork monitor seems like geth was goofy at the beginning regardless - congrats all that contributed - grateful for you all 🫡 per Tim: https://twitter.com/TimBeiko/status/1646280917638344705?s=20 where can one monitor withdrawal queue?
